subject: Air freight quote request to PVG
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the cheapest air freight option to PVG (Shanghai, CN)? The shipment will be ready for pickup at our site in Offenbach, Germany (postcode 63198), on 2026-11-25. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 9 pieces of furniture samples, with a gross weight of 1225 kg and a total volume of 4.62 cbm.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR, including pickup and trucking to the airport.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH
